info.title: STJW workspace API
info.description: Implemented workforce, calendar, internal messaging, school records, attendance and longitudinal reports, admissions, class grading, annual report cards, academic timetables, childcare, staff-operated dismissal and private report-library routes. Response objects remain open in this initial contract; canonical runtime validation is in shared contracts and server modules. Optional authenticator MFA, imported financial comparisons and reviewed grade CSV imports are included. Parent arrival and Google integrations remain unimplemented. Accounting routes include session-only ledger, documents, banking, budgets and explicitly entered payroll with exact money and retained evidence.
